主要内容: The document titled '6-K' is a filing by the Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing, dated January 9, 2014, is a Form 6-K report under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The report is submitted in accordance with Rule 15d-16, indicating that the bank files annual reports under Form 40-F. The filing includes an exhibit titled 'Charter of the Board of Directors,' which outlines the governance structure of the bank's board. The document is signed by Carol J. McNamara, who holds the title of Vice-President, Associate General Counsel & Secretary. This filing is part of the bank's regulatory reporting obligations and provides insight into its internal governance framework.
